'''Kaz Denko''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a member of the [[Ash'ad]] group. He was the nephew of [[Rykal Denko]]. He participated in the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]] against [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|Mandalore the Avenger's faction]] and was killed in the fighting.<ref name="Ruhnuk" />
